Where you look decides whether the problem wins.

Kevin explains that the simple technique for facing adversity is to keep your eye on the goal, not on the problem. He asks whether you are staring at what's wrong or at what you want.

When your eye stays on the dream, he says, the problem gets overcome along the way, because you become what you think about most of the time.

Where is your attention right now?
